1ezigp3.q: The sign shown prohibits traffic in both directions
1ezigp3.why: The no-entry-for-all-vehicles sign (divieto di transito, empty red circle) closes the road to traffic in both directions.

5cdz90.q: The sign shown prohibits the passage of all vehicles
5cdz90.why: The empty red circle bans every category of vehicle, with no exception by vehicle type.

6x0cc4.q: The sign shown prohibits the circulation of motor quadricycles
6x0cc4.why: The ban covers every vehicle, so motor quadricycles are included.

wsefjs.q: The sign shown is placed at both entrances of the road
wsefjs.why: Since it bans traffic in both directions, the sign is placed at both ends (accessi) of the road.

13meexg.q: The sign shown prohibits the passage of trucks
13meexg.why: The sign bans all vehicles, so trucks are included.

jkjso7.q: The sign shown may have limited validity in time, indicated on a supplementary panel
jkjso7.why: A supplementary panel (pannello integrativo) can limit the ban to certain days or hours.

3a72ju.q: The sign shown allows pedestrians to pass
3a72ju.why: The ban applies to vehicles only, so pedestrians may still pass.

kvzkp7.q: The sign shown prohibits the circulation of mopeds
kvzkp7.why: Mopeds (ciclomotori) are vehicles, so they fall under the general ban.

1qtm7an.q: The sign shown is a NO ENTRY FOR ALL VEHICLES sign (divieto di transito)
1qtm7an.why: A red ring with an empty white centre is the divieto di transito sign.

ww0rap.q: The sign shown allows bicycles to pass
ww0rap.why: Bicycles are vehicles, so the ban applies to them as well.

nzmm7s.q: The sign shown prohibits passage only to motor vehicles
nzmm7s.why: The ban applies to all vehicles, including non-motorised ones such as bicycles.

14j3aop.q: The sign shown normally allows entering the road to park and to load and unload
14j3aop.why: The ban also forbids entering to park or to load and unload, unless a supplementary panel gives an exception.

1upoij2.q: The sign shown does not allow entering the road, only leaving it
1upoij2.why: The sign bans traffic in both directions, so both entering and leaving are prohibited.

152992v.q: The sign shown indicates that traffic is one-way
152992v.why: The sign closes the road in both directions; one-way traffic is shown by different signs.

1o5vhza.q: The sign shown allows passage to electric cars
1o5vhza.why: The ban covers all vehicles, whatever their power source.

1ihp1ex.q: The sign shown is a danger sign
1ihp1ex.why: It is a prohibition sign (red circle). Danger signs are triangular.

jl2jkn.q: The sign shown, if crossed out in red, indicates the end of the ban
jl2jkn.why: The sign shown imposes the ban. Its end is shown by a separate end-of-prohibition sign (fine prescrizione) with diagonal bars.

ym0kco.q: The sign shown prohibits entering a road that is instead accessible from the other end
ym0kco.why: The no-entry sign (senso vietato) stops you entering from this end of a one-way road, which is open from the opposite end.

1666am3.q: Vehicles without an engine must respect the prohibition imposed by the sign shown
1666am3.why: The no-entry sign applies to all vehicles, including bicycles and other non-motorised ones.

1gb6so5.q: Taxis must respect the prohibition imposed by the sign shown
1gb6so5.why: There is no exception for taxis; they must obey like any other vehicle.

7g0bh6.q: Motor quadricycles must respect the prohibition imposed by the sign shown
7g0bh6.why: The no-entry sign binds all vehicles, motor quadricycles included.

cfdfoe.q: The prohibition imposed by the sign shown must be respected also at night
cfdfoe.why: The sign applies 24 hours a day, with no time limits.

s1cfl5.q: The sign shown is placed on a one-way road
s1cfl5.why: The sign is placed at the end of a one-way road that you may not enter from there.

rxdybb.q: The sign shown is a NO ENTRY sign (senso vietato)
rxdybb.why: A red circle with a horizontal white bar is the senso vietato (wrong way / no entry) sign.

1aoejc6.q: The sign shown allows access to motorcycles
1aoejc6.why: The sign bans access to all vehicles, motorcycles included.

lfhi1f.q: The sign shown allows access to mopeds
lfhi1f.why: Mopeds (ciclomotori) must obey the no-entry sign too.

1lshkc.q: The sign shown does not allow vehicles to circulate on that road
1lshkc.why: The sign only bans entering from that end; traffic can use the road in the opposite direction.

1pm9rl4.q: The sign shown is placed on a two-way carriageway
1pm9rl4.why: The sign marks a one-way road, not a two-way carriageway.

1hpj7vc.q: The sign shown prohibits parking but not stopping
1hpj7vc.why: The sign has nothing to do with parking or stopping; it bans entry for all vehicles from that side.

178ytyg.why: The no-entry sign bans entering the road; overtaking bans use a different sign.

3dggm3.q: The sign shown allows local traffic to circulate in both directions
3dggm3.why: The sign has no local-traffic exception and never allows driving in the prohibited direction.

u0nq8j.q: The prohibition imposed by the sign shown must be respected, in built-up areas, from 8.00 to 20.00
u0nq8j.why: The no-entry sign always applies, day and night, including in built-up areas.

1t50kv0.q: The sign shown is a NO ENTRY FOR ALL VEHICLES sign (divieto di transito)
1t50kv0.why: It is the senso vietato (wrong way) sign, distinct from the divieto di transito (empty red circle) by its white bar.

6u376j.q: The sign shown allows a car to overtake a motorcycle
6u376j.why: The no-overtaking ban does not cover motorcycles and mopeds, so they may be overtaken.

500xi8.q: The sign shown can be found on both urban and extra-urban roads
500xi8.why: The no-overtaking sign can be placed on any road, urban or extra-urban.

1goy7gj.q: Sign (A) may be repeated after each junction with supplementary panel (B)
1goy7gj.why: A no-overtaking ban lapses at a junction unless repeated; with the arrow panel it may be repeated after each junction.

u6vu9o.q: The sign shown prohibits overtaking trucks
u6vu9o.why: The sign bans overtaking motor vehicles, so trucks are included.

18pjsfx.q: The sign shown allows overtaking mopeds
18pjsfx.why: Mopeds (ciclomotori) are excluded from the ban and may be overtaken.

me0u5p.q: The sign shown prohibits overtaking between motor vehicles, even if the manoeuvre can be completed within one half of the carriageway
me0u5p.why: The ban applies to motor vehicles regardless of whether the manoeuvre stays within the driver's own half of the road.

19kjv4h.q: With the sign shown, a truck may overtake a motorcycle
19kjv4h.why: Motorcycles are excluded from the ban and can be overtaken by any vehicle, trucks included.

19q9fll.q: With the sign shown, a car may overtake a moped
19q9fll.why: Mopeds are not covered by the ban and may be overtaken.

1o9usne.q: The sign shown allows articulated lorries, road trains and articulated buses to pass
1o9usne.why: The sign bans overtaking only, not passage, so these vehicles may drive through normally.

3uup90.q: With the sign shown, it is forbidden to overtake motor vehicles with a mass under 3.5 tonnes too
3uup90.why: The sign covers all motor vehicles whatever their mass; the 3.5 t limit belongs to a different sign.

1o8c2p7.q: With the sign shown, it is forbidden to overtake motor vehicles other than motorcycles and mopeds
1o8c2p7.why: The ban covers motor vehicles, except two-wheeled motorcycles and mopeds.

dd96pg.q: With the sign shown, overtaking animal-drawn vehicles is allowed
dd96pg.why: Animal-drawn vehicles are not motor vehicles, so they may be overtaken.

q3p4ub.q: With the sign shown, overtaking two-wheeled mopeds is allowed
q3p4ub.why: Two-wheeled mopeds are excluded from the no-overtaking ban.

zth76o.q: With the sign shown, overtaking motorcycles is allowed
zth76o.why: Motorcycles are excluded from the no-overtaking ban.

kixqtb.q: The sign shown allows overtaking bicycles
kixqtb.why: Bicycles are not motor vehicles and may be overtaken.

1o5sxz6.q: With the sign shown, overtaking vehicles without an engine is allowed
1o5sxz6.why: Vehicles without an engine are not covered by the ban.

rrs6xo.q: With the sign shown, overtaking hand-drawn or hand-pushed vehicles is allowed
rrs6xo.why: Hand-propelled vehicles have no engine, so they may be overtaken.

1jqptlk.q: With the sign shown, overtaking horse-drawn carriages is allowed
1jqptlk.why: Horse-drawn carriages are not motor vehicles and may be overtaken.

r5chtz.q: The sign shown allows a motorcycle to overtake a car
r5chtz.why: The ban applies to motorcycles too when they want to overtake a four-wheeled motor vehicle.

v18fkb.q: The sign shown indicates that the right lane is reserved for slow vehicles
v18fkb.why: The sign bans overtaking between motor vehicles; it does not reserve any lane.

d1bom.q: The sign shown allows overtaking a car as long as the solid line is not crossed
d1bom.why: Overtaking a car is forbidden in every case, even without crossing any line.

ouc21d.q: The sign shown prohibits a motorcycle from overtaking a bicycle
ouc21d.why: Bicycles are not covered by the ban and can be overtaken even by motorcycles.

p8fjhy.q: The sign shown allows overtaking between cars if there is no solid white line
p8fjhy.why: The ban applies regardless of road markings; overtaking between cars is forbidden.

lcw418.q: The sign shown allows a car to overtake a truck
lcw418.why: A truck is a motor vehicle, so it may not be overtaken.

1lrvb0e.q: The sign shown is found only on main extra-urban roads
1lrvb0e.why: The sign can be placed on any road, urban ones included.

glqcrk.q: With the sign shown, it is forbidden to overtake any vehicle
glqcrk.why: The ban does not cover motorcycles, mopeds, bicycles and non-motorised vehicles, which may be overtaken.

cv9p1f.q: With the sign shown, passage is forbidden to cars
cv9p1f.why: The sign bans overtaking, not the passage of cars.

szxv54.q: The sign shown requires giving way in alternating one-way sections
szxv54.why: The sign bans overtaking; priority at alternating one-way sections is shown by other signs.

k3xcs5.q: The sign shown allows a motorcycle to overtake a bus
k3xcs5.why: A bus is a motor vehicle, so even a motorcycle may not overtake it.

13dhq0a.q: With the sign shown, overtaking electric motor vehicles is allowed
13dhq0a.why: Electric vehicles are still motor vehicles and may not be overtaken.

1ij7tuw.q: The sign shown warns of a narrowing of the road
1ij7tuw.why: The sign bans overtaking; a road narrowing is shown by a triangular danger sign.

16okrqf.q: With the sign shown, overtaking agricultural machines is allowed
16okrqf.why: Agricultural machines are motor vehicles and fall under the ban.

1b6qlbn.q: With the sign shown, overtaking operating machines is allowed
1b6qlbn.why: Operating machines (macchine operatrici) are motor vehicles and may not be overtaken.

1naoyb2.q: With the sign shown, overtaking motor vehicles travelling very slowly is allowed
1naoyb2.why: Slow speed is no exception; motor vehicles may not be overtaken.

1kf2xlz.q: With the sign shown, overtaking vehicles that have signalled an intention to turn right is allowed
1kf2xlz.why: The ban has no exception for vehicles signalling a right turn.

141af7q.q: With the sign shown, it is mandatory to keep a distance of at least 70 metres from the vehicle ahead
141af7q.why: The sign requires keeping at least the stated distance from the vehicle in front.

jva039.q: With the sign shown, a vehicle may travel 80 metres behind the one ahead
jva039.why: 80 m is more than the 70 m minimum shown, so it is allowed.

i2zvz2.q: The sign shown prohibits a vehicle from travelling less than 70 metres from the one ahead
i2zvz2.why: The sign sets a minimum following distance of 70 m.

1ge5dmw.q: The sign shown also applies to motorcycles
1ge5dmw.why: The rule applies to all vehicles, motorcycles included.

11evobq.q: The sign shown must be respected even when travelling at low speed
11evobq.why: The minimum distance must always be kept, even at low speed.

vozbp9.q: The sign shown requires respecting the minimum distance indicated
vozbp9.why: The sign obliges drivers to keep at least the distance shown.

qa0qog.q: The sign shown requires vehicles to travel less than 70 metres from one another
qa0qog.why: The sign requires at least 70 m, not less.

13l4ro.q: The sign shown requires the vehicle in front to keep at least 70 metres from the one following
13l4ro.why: The duty is on the following driver, who must stay at least 70 m behind the vehicle ahead.

1cfqnkn.q: The sign shown indicates the maximum distance to keep, only on road sections where overtaking is prohibited
1cfqnkn.why: It shows a minimum, not maximum, distance and applies wherever it is placed.

h09bhq.q: The sign shown warns that in 70 metres a ban on passage for cars begins
h09bhq.why: It is not an advance warning; it immediately imposes a 70 m minimum distance from the vehicle ahead.

gvuhj7.q: With the sign shown, cars may not exceed 70 km/h
gvuhj7.why: The number is a distance in metres, not a speed limit.

96wapm.q: The sign shown indicates the maximum length of the tow rope
96wapm.why: The sign shows the minimum distance between moving vehicles, nothing to do with a tow rope.

1yum480.q: The sign shown is a prohibition sign
1yum480.why: A circle with a red border is a prohibition sign, here a speed limit.

244lqo.q: With the sign shown, exceeding 80 km/h is prohibited
244lqo.why: The sign sets a maximum speed of 80 km/h.

u71unq.q: The sign shown may also be found on motorways
u71unq.why: Speed limits can also be imposed on motorways, for example at roadworks or dangerous stretches.

1kmspjk.q: The speed limit indicated on the sign shown is valid immediately after the sign itself
1kmspjk.why: The limit applies right after the sign, until an end-of-limit sign or the next junction.

1p59hnx.q: The sign shown requires driving at a speed of 80 km/h or less
1p59hnx.why: The number in the red circle is the maximum limit, so you may drive at 80 km/h or slower.

yno8h5.q: The sign shown is a prescriptive sign
yno8h5.why: Speed limit signs are regulatory signs (segnali di prescrizione) because they impose a mandatory behaviour.

9f6iab.q: The sign shown prohibits vehicles from exceeding the indicated speed
9f6iab.why: The sign sets a maximum speed, so going above the number shown is forbidden.

fx7l7i.q: The sign shown requires compliance with a maximum speed limit
fx7l7i.why: A red circle with a number sets a maximum speed limit that you must obey.

uoyvxv.q: The sign shown indicates the maximum speed at which vehicles may travel
uoyvxv.why: The figure on the sign is the highest speed allowed from that point on.

7uaukx.q: The sign shown imposes the obligation to travel at a speed not exceeding 80 km/h
7uaukx.why: The sign obliges you not to exceed 80 km/h from where it is placed.

1fpzcvm.q: The number shown on the sign indicates the maximum permitted speed
1fpzcvm.why: The number on a speed limit sign is always the maximum speed in km/h.

1irrwkz.q: The sign shown allows driving at a speed lower than the one indicated
1irrwkz.why: The sign sets only a maximum, so driving slower is always permitted as long as it is safe.

ovx112.q: The sign shown requires keeping a safety distance of at least 80 metres
ovx112.why: The sign gives a speed limit. A minimum following distance uses a different sign showing metres.

1529kdh.q: The sign shown does not apply to motorcycles
1529kdh.why: A speed limit applies to all vehicles, motorcycles included, unless a panel says otherwise.

1o5z4hy.q: The sign shown indicates the recommended speed
1o5z4hy.why: A red circle gives a mandatory limit. Recommended speeds are shown on blue square signs.

6e0b9b.q: The sign shown allows overtaking at a speed above 80 km/h
6e0b9b.why: The 80 km/h limit also applies while overtaking, so you can never exceed it.

1613etp.q: The sign shown prohibits the passage of vehicles with a total mass above 80 quintals
1613etp.why: The number is a speed in km/h, not a weight. Weight bans show tonnes on a different sign.

1ipfm02.q: The sign shown requires compliance with a minimum speed limit
1ipfm02.why: The sign sets a maximum. A minimum speed is shown by a blue mandatory sign.

13a1jp0.q: The sign shown prohibits the passage of vehicles that, by construction, cannot reach the indicated speed
13a1jp0.why: The sign does not ban slow vehicles. It only forbids exceeding the speed shown.

1jeujs6.q: The sign shown indicates a speed limit valid only for motor cars
1jeujs6.why: The limit applies to all vehicles, not only cars, unless a supplementary panel says otherwise.

mtnww5.q: The sign shown requires compliance with the indicated minimum speed limit
mtnww5.why: The number is a maximum speed, not a minimum.

168sanw.q: The sign shown requires vehicles unable to exceed 80 km/h to travel in the right-hand lane
168sanw.why: The sign does not require any particular lane. It only gives the maximum speed.

kx31xj.q: The speed limit indicated by the sign shown takes effect 150 metres after the sign itself
kx31xj.why: The limit applies from the point where the sign stands, with no delay distance.

1o36ay2.q: The sign shown prohibits the passage of motor vehicles with a total mass exceeding the indicated value
1o36ay2.why: The number is a speed, not a weight. Weight limits are shown in tonnes on other signs.

19h6zbg.q: The sign shown indicates a speed limit valid from 8:00 to 20:00
19h6zbg.why: The limit applies 24 hours a day unless a supplementary panel shows specific hours.

kw43v7.q: The sign shown prohibits the use of the horn
kw43v7.why: The sign forbids using the horn (avvisatore acustico) in the area where it is placed.

i2so8d.q: The sign shown prohibits acoustic signals
i2so8d.why: The crossed-out horn symbol forbids acoustic signals.

1vp9773.q: The sign shown indicates the start of a zone where sounding the horn is prohibited
1vp9773.why: The ban begins at this sign and lasts until an end-of-prohibition sign or the next intersection.

gqfhlv.q: With the sign shown, the horn may be used if transporting seriously injured or ill people
gqfhlv.why: The ban does not apply to those carrying seriously injured or ill people, who may use the horn when needed.

1esrk5r.q: The sign shown allows the use of the horn to attract attention in any circumstance
1esrk5r.why: The sign bans the horn. It may be used only for immediate danger, not just to get attention.

1e398d8.q: The sign shown must be obeyed only from 20:00 to 8:00
1e398d8.why: The ban applies 24 hours a day unless a supplementary panel states otherwise.

1baahzx.q: The sign shown warns of a possible fire station
1baahzx.why: It is a prohibition sign (red circle) against acoustic signals, not a warning sign.

1k89ckd.q: The sign shown warns of a narrowing on mountain roads
1k89ckd.why: It is a prohibition sign, not a danger sign: it forbids acoustic signals.

1nsy5tp.q: The sign shown allows the use of the horn in cases of traffic jams
1nsy5tp.why: The horn stays forbidden in a traffic jam. It is allowed only for immediate danger.

a6z6eu.q: The sign shown indicates the end of the prohibition of acoustic signals
a6z6eu.why: This sign marks the start of the ban. The end is shown by a separate end-of-prohibition sign.

10gfdxw.q: The sign shown prohibits vehicles with a full-load mass above 3.5 tonnes that are not intended for passenger transport from overtaking motor vehicles
10gfdxw.why: The ban applies to goods vehicles with a full-load mass above 3.5 t.

s8t66z.q: With the sign shown, a lorry cannot overtake motor vehicles if its registration document states a full-load mass above 3.5 tonnes
s8t66z.why: What counts is the full-load mass on the registration document (carta di circolazione). Above 3.5 t a lorry cannot overtake.

1m32kqg.q: The sign shown allows a lorry with a full-load mass below 3.5 tonnes to overtake an articulated lorry
1m32kqg.why: The ban applies only above 3.5 t full-load mass. Below that a lorry may overtake.

jhwav.q: The sign shown allows a bus with a full-load mass of 18 tonnes to overtake a road train
jhwav.why: Buses carry passengers, so the ban does not apply to them whatever their mass.

j3m713.q: With the sign shown, a car with a full-load mass of 3 tonnes towing a light trailer may overtake motor vehicles
j3m713.why: The ban concerns goods vehicles above 3.5 t. A car towing a light trailer (carrello appendice) may overtake.

srkz6l.q: With the sign shown, a car may overtake a road train
srkz6l.why: The ban does not apply to cars, which may overtake even a road train (autotreno).

ju5r5f.q: With the sign shown, a motorhome with a full-load mass of 4 tonnes may carry out overtaking manoeuvres
ju5r5f.why: A motorhome (autocaravan) is not a goods vehicle, so the ban does not apply even above 3.5 t.

1p7sutb.q: With the sign shown, lorries with a full-load mass above 3.5 t are prohibited from overtaking a motorcycle
1p7sutb.why: The ban covers overtaking any motor vehicle, motorcycles included.

101weli.q: With the sign shown, a lorry with a maximum full-load mass above 3.5 tonnes towing a light trailer may overtake a motorcycle
101weli.why: The ban applies to lorries above 3.5 t even with a light trailer, and it includes motorcycles.

w1hf7s.q: With the sign shown, a motorhome with a full-load mass above 3.5 tonnes cannot overtake motor vehicles
w1hf7s.why: A motorhome is not a goods vehicle, so it may overtake.

1g2fg3y.q: The sign shown allows a lorry with a total mass above 3.5 tonnes to overtake a motorcycle
1g2fg3y.why: The ban on lorries above 3.5 t includes overtaking motorcycles.

2ev6dr.q: The sign shown allows cars to overtake lorries on the right-hand lane
2ev6dr.why: The sign says nothing about lanes. Overtaking on the right remains forbidden except in cases the code allows.

pj93uo.q: The sign shown prohibits articulated buses from overtaking
pj93uo.why: Articulated buses (autosnodati) carry passengers, so the ban does not apply to them.

9nj3op.q: The sign shown prohibits a motorhome with a total mass of 6 tonnes from overtaking
9nj3op.why: A motorhome is not a goods vehicle, so the ban does not apply even at 6 t.

1ycbgl5.q: With the sign shown, a lorry with a full-load mass of 3 tonnes cannot overtake
1ycbgl5.why: The ban applies only above 3.5 t, so a 3 t lorry may overtake.

1ms0dh9.q: With the sign shown, vehicles with a full-load mass above 3.5 tonnes intended for passenger transport cannot overtake
1ms0dh9.why: The ban does not apply to passenger-carrying vehicles whatever their mass.

bf0ico.q: The sign shown prohibits the passage of animal-drawn vehicles
bf0ico.why: The picture shows a horse-drawn cart, so the sign bans animal-drawn vehicles.

f14gf3.q: The sign shown prohibits the passage of vehicles drawn by horses
f14gf3.why: The horse pulling a cart means animal-drawn vehicles are banned.

18hcmze.q: The sign shown prohibits the circulation of horse-drawn carriages
18hcmze.why: Horse-drawn carriages are animal-drawn vehicles, so they cannot pass.

65tuod.q: The sign shown prohibits the passage of vehicles drawn by donkeys
65tuod.why: The ban covers any animal-drawn vehicle, donkeys included.

1khkhgg.q: The sign shown allows the passage of motorcycles
1khkhgg.why: The ban targets only animal-drawn vehicles. Other vehicles, motorcycles included, may pass.

1io2aic.q: The sign shown allows the passage of motor vehicles
1io2aic.why: Only animal-drawn vehicles are banned, so motor cars may pass.

2xyrhn.q: The sign shown prohibits the passage of motor vehicles
2xyrhn.why: The sign bans only animal-drawn vehicles, not motor vehicles.

ixd3o5.q: The sign shown applies, in built-up areas, from 8:00 to 20:00
ixd3o5.why: The ban applies around the clock unless a supplementary panel shows hours.

304n8.q: The sign shown allows the passage of animal-drawn vehicles if fitted with pneumatic tyres
304n8.why: The ban makes no exception for tyre type. Animal-drawn vehicles may not pass.

1wwlnjw.q: The sign shown indicates a road reserved for agricultural carts
1wwlnjw.why: It is a prohibition sign. It reserves nothing and instead bans animal-drawn vehicles.

xj3r2e.q: The sign shown prohibits the passage of hand-pushed vehicles
xj3r2e.why: Hand-pushed vehicles (veicoli a braccia) have their own sign with a hand cart. This one shows an animal.

19gnngu.q: The sign shown prohibits the circulation of all vehicles without an engine
19gnngu.why: Only animal-drawn vehicles are banned. Bicycles and other non-motorised vehicles may pass.

xo8yhl.q: The sign shown prohibits pedestrians from passing
xo8yhl.why: The pedestrian figure in a red circle bans pedestrians.

17cunjl.q: The sign shown allows the passage of motor cars
17cunjl.why: Only pedestrians are banned, so cars may pass.

13qnjul.q: The sign shown allows the passage of motorcycles
13qnjul.why: The sign bans only pedestrians, so motorcycles may pass.

13vcp5h.q: The sign shown allows the passage of motor quadricycles
13vcp5h.why: The ban applies only to pedestrians, so motor quadricycles may pass.

pkre9g.q: The sign shown allows the passage of bicycles
pkre9g.why: Only pedestrians are banned, so bicycles may pass.

1nrgc3q.q: The sign shown prohibits the passage of mopeds
1nrgc3q.why: The sign bans only pedestrians, so mopeds may pass.

1f658yc.q: The sign shown applies from 8:00 to 20:00
1f658yc.why: The ban applies 24 hours a day unless a supplementary panel shows hours.

am4qul.q: The sign shown indicates an urban area reserved for a playground and amusements
am4qul.why: It is a prohibition sign banning pedestrians, not a sign for play areas.

mqh0bb.q: The sign shown requires pedestrians to walk on the left edge of the carriageway
mqh0bb.why: The sign bans pedestrians altogether. It does not tell them which side to walk on.

1bx1cy6.q: The sign shown indicates the start of a pedestrian path
1bx1cy6.why: A pedestrian path is shown by a blue mandatory sign. This red circle bans pedestrians.

mx21qv.q: The sign shown prohibits the passage of bicycles
mx21qv.why: The bicycle in a red circle bans bicycles.

3oxa7u.q: The sign shown is a prohibition sign
3oxa7u.why: A white sign with a red circle is the form of a prohibition sign (segnale di divieto).

b6kzpe.q: The sign shown allows the passage of motor quadricycles
b6kzpe.why: Only bicycles are banned, so motor quadricycles may pass.

1ksiq88.q: The sign shown allows the passage of pedestrians
1ksiq88.why: The ban concerns bicycles, so pedestrians may pass.

gpd6bt.q: The sign shown allows the passage of two-wheeled mopeds
gpd6bt.why: The sign bans bicycles, so two-wheeled mopeds may pass.

wew4a9.q: The sign shown prohibits the passage of pedal quadricycles
wew4a9.why: Pedal quadricycles count as cycles (velocipedi), so they are banned like bicycles.

q2a8kw.q: The sign shown prohibits the passage of tandems
q2a8kw.why: A tandem is a cycle, so it falls under the bicycle ban.

1ngju1v.q: The sign shown applies from 8:00 to 20:00
1ngju1v.why: The ban applies 24 hours a day unless a supplementary panel shows hours.

a199fi.q: The sign shown allows bicycles to pass at night
a199fi.why: The ban has no night-time exception. Bicycles cannot pass at any hour.

j773n0.q: The sign shown prohibits the passage of motorcycles

1qc1znt.q: The sign shown prohibits the passage of mopeds

auywto.q: The sign shown prohibits the passage of vehicles whose most heavily loaded axle exceeds the actual mass indicated
auywto.why: The sign bans vehicles whose most heavily loaded axle carries more than the actual mass shown.

148d4xa.q: With the sign shown, passage is allowed for trucks with an actual axle mass of 2.5 tonnes
148d4xa.why: The ban applies above 2.5 t per axle. Exactly 2.5 t may pass.

18erb08.q: The sign shown prohibits the passage of vehicles with an actual mass per axle exceeding 2.5 tonnes
18erb08.why: The sign bans vehicles whose actual mass per axle exceeds 2.5 t.

xkd3su.q: The sign shown refers to the actual mass on the axle at the time of passage
xkd3su.why: What counts is the actual mass on the axle at the moment of passage, load included.

sx95fe.q: The sign shown may be found before a bridge
sx95fe.why: Axle load limits are often placed before bridges with limited capacity.

1522mq5.q: The sign shown requires vehicles with a mass per axle over 2.5 tonnes to proceed at walking pace
1522mq5.why: The sign bans such vehicles from passing. It does not require walking pace.

2ddyod.q: The sign shown prohibits the passage of trucks with a total mass exceeding the one indicated
2ddyod.why: The sign limits the load on the most heavily loaded axle, not total mass.

vmwfkd.q: The sign shown applies only to motor vehicles with twin wheels
vmwfkd.why: The limit applies to any vehicle, whatever its type of wheels.

14bpb0g.q: The sign shown, in built-up areas, applies from 8:00 to 20:00
14bpb0g.why: The axle load ban applies at all times, with no time limit.

19lo717.q: The sign shown prohibits the passage of all vehicles with a full-load total mass exceeding 2.5 tonnes
19lo717.why: The 2.5 t limit concerns mass per axle, not the vehicle's total mass.

l8ko1x.q: The sign shown indicates the end of the previously imposed restrictions
l8ko1x.why: The sign with the black diagonal bar marks the end of all previously imposed restrictions (fine prescrizioni).

67nhrz.q: The sign shown indicates the end of previously imposed prohibitions
67nhrz.why: The plain white sign with a black diagonal bar marks the end of all previously imposed prohibitions and restrictions (fine prescrizione).

10a3tf2.q: The sign shown is a clear-road sign (via libera)
10a3tf2.why: The black diagonal bar on white is the via libera sign: all earlier prohibitions end at this point.

15xw7sm.q: The sign shown is an end-of-restriction sign (fine prescrizione)
15xw7sm.why: The plain white sign with a black diagonal bar marks the end of all previously imposed prohibitions and restrictions (fine prescrizione).

gdmz6i.q: The sign shown indicates the point from which the previously indicated restrictions are no longer valid
gdmz6i.why: From the point where it stands, the restrictions and prohibitions shown earlier no longer apply.

1suvbpa.q: The sign shown indicates the end of a roadwork site
1suvbpa.why: It has nothing to do with roadworks: the black bar cancels earlier prohibitions. The end of works is shown by other signs.

1029srf.q: The sign shown applies only to vehicles in public service
1029srf.why: The end-of-prohibitions sign applies to all vehicles, not only those in public service (servizio pubblico).

xvfcg8.q: The sign shown is an information sign
xvfcg8.why: It is a regulatory sign (segnale di prescrizione), not an information sign: it ends earlier prohibitions.

15z2ta8.q: The sign shown indicates the end of a built-up area
15z2ta8.why: The end of a built-up area (centro abitato) is shown by a white information sign with the place name crossed out, not by this sign.

1gn6owp.q: The sign shown indicates the end of the danger previously signalled
1gn6owp.why: It ends prohibitions, not dangers. Warning signs have no end-of-danger sign.

7v7cf8.q: The sign shown indicates the end of a restriction
7v7cf8.why: The black bar over 50 marks the end of the 50 km/h maximum speed limit, which is a restriction (prescrizione).

7bexal.q: The sign shown indicates the end of the maximum speed limit
7bexal.why: The black bar over 50 means the 50 km/h maximum speed limit ends here.

112fp49.q: The sign shown allows driving at a speed above 50 km/h
112fp49.why: Once the 50 km/h limit ends, you may exceed it, but only within the limit for that type of road.

1cao8qf.q: The sign shown allows driving within the speed limits in force for that type of road
1cao8qf.why: After the sign, the general limits for the road apply (e.g. 50 km/h in built-up areas, 90 km/h on secondary rural roads).

f3vv6t.q: The sign shown allows driving even at a speed below 50 km/h
f3vv6t.why: It cancels only a maximum limit. No minimum applies, so you may drive slower, as long as you do not hinder traffic.

yw1iu3.q: The sign shown indicates the end of the relevant prohibition
yw1iu3.why: It ends the earlier prohibition on exceeding 50 km/h.

bprlv0.q: The sign shown indicates the speed limit for all vehicles
bprlv0.why: It does not set a limit: the black bar cancels the 50 km/h maximum limit, so it marks the end of one.

4b13qg.q: The sign shown prohibits exceeding a speed of 50 km/h
4b13qg.why: The sign that bans exceeding 50 km/h is round with a red border. This one, with the black bar, ends that ban.

1dwsz2n.q: The sign shown indicates the end of the minimum speed limit
1dwsz2n.why: This sign ends a maximum limit. A minimum speed limit is shown by a blue mandatory sign, which is different.

1w48el2.q: The sign shown indicates the end of the obligation to keep a safety distance of at least 50 metres
1w48el2.why: The 50 is a speed in km/h, not a distance. The minimum-distance obligation is shown by a different sign.

p1a7ye.q: The sign shown requires vehicles not exceeding 50 km/h to drive in the right-hand lane
p1a7ye.why: It does not require any lane. It only marks the end of the 50 km/h maximum speed limit.

116urpk.q: The sign shown indicates the recommended speed
116urpk.why: Recommended speed is shown on a blue square sign. This sign ends the 50 km/h maximum limit.

9xtt6.q: The sign shown indicates the end of the previously imposed overtaking ban
9xtt6.why: The two cars with the black bar mark the end of the overtaking ban imposed earlier.

1qp4nh6.q: With the sign shown, overtaking is prohibited if a continuous line has to be crossed
1qp4nh6.why: The sign ends the overtaking ban but not the continuous line, which still may not be crossed.

qq7u7.q: The sign shown indicates the point where the overtaking ban ends
qq7u7.why: The overtaking ban shown earlier ends at the point where this sign stands.

1ab0r5b.q: The sign shown does not impose any particular speed limit
1ab0r5b.why: It concerns only overtaking. It neither sets nor cancels any speed limit.

18317x.q: The sign shown can be placed both in built-up areas and outside them
18317x.why: End-of-overtaking-ban signs can be placed both inside and outside built-up areas (centri abitati).

1gf6h1w.q: The sign shown is an end-of-restriction sign (fine prescrizione)
1gf6h1w.why: It ends the overtaking ban, so it is an end-of-restriction sign (fine prescrizione).

riuaew.q: The sign shown is valid for all 24 hours
riuaew.why: The sign has no time limit: it applies 24 hours a day unless a supplementary panel says otherwise.

16vzlds.q: The sign shown indicates the end of the overtaking ban between cars only
16vzlds.why: It is not limited to cars: it ends the overtaking ban for all motor vehicles.

16ojaco.q: The sign shown indicates the end of the ban on transit for all motor vehicles
16ojaco.why: It concerns overtaking, not transit. A transit ban is shown by a plain red circle.

d2upyd.q: The sign shown prohibits driving in parallel lines
d2upyd.why: It does not ban driving in parallel lines. It marks the end of the overtaking ban.

x6uy7u.q: The sign shown indicates the end of the maximum speed limit
x6uy7u.why: The two cars refer to overtaking, not speed. An end-of-speed-limit sign shows a number.

wx7n7n.q: The sign shown indicates the end of the no-parking ban on both sides of the road
wx7n7n.why: It has nothing to do with parking. It only ends the overtaking ban.

1773bnw.q: The sign shown indicates that the obligation to keep a safety distance has ended
1773bnw.why: The safety distance (distanza di sicurezza) must always be kept. This sign concerns overtaking only.

15lyc87.q: The sign shown indicates the end of the ban on double parking
15lyc87.why: It does not concern parking. It only marks the end of the overtaking ban.

njk4vx.q: With the sign shown, a 44-tonne articulated lorry may overtake a car
njk4vx.why: The sign ends the overtaking ban for goods vehicles over 3.5 t, so the articulated lorry (autotreno) may overtake a car.

15kwnj1.q: The sign shown indicates the end of the previously imposed overtaking ban
15kwnj1.why: It marks the end of the overtaking ban imposed on heavy goods vehicles.

6420ef.q: With the sign shown, a lorry may overtake a bus
6420ef.why: With the ban on goods vehicles over 3.5 t ended, a lorry (autocarro) may overtake, including a bus.

1572z5y.q: The sign shown indicates the end of the overtaking ban for goods vehicles with a laden mass over 3.5 tonnes
1572z5y.why: The lorry and car shown mark the end of the overtaking ban for goods vehicles with a laden mass above 3.5 t.

kwna3t.q: The sign shown is an end-of-restriction sign (fine prescrizione)
kwna3t.why: The black bar marks the end of a prohibition, so it is an end-of-restriction sign (fine prescrizione).

5zhv37.q: With the sign shown, the transit of road trains, articulated buses and articulated lorries is prohibited
5zhv37.why: It does not ban transit. It ends the overtaking ban for goods vehicles over 3.5 t.

1oys5cr.q: With the sign shown, cars must overtake lorries in the right-hand lane
1oys5cr.why: The sign imposes no lane. Overtaking is still done on the left as a general rule.

1xlbsvo.q: The sign shown indicates the end of the overtaking ban for buses with a laden mass over 3.5 tonnes
1xlbsvo.why: The ended ban applied to goods vehicles, not buses, so the sign does not refer to buses.

1q3eb3x.q: The sign shown is a warning sign
1q3eb3x.why: It is a regulatory sign (segnale di prescrizione): it ends a prohibition and does not warn of any danger.

17lkvhn.q: The sign shown does not apply to lorries with a gross mass of 7 tonnes
17lkvhn.why: A 7 t lorry exceeds 3.5 t, so the sign does apply to it and ends its overtaking ban.

17wcnu4.q: The sign shown is placed where parking is prohibited
17wcnu4.why: The no-parking sign is placed where parking (sosta) is prohibited, i.e. where you may not leave the vehicle.

1q29r9h.q: The sign shown prohibits parking on urban roads from 8:00 to 20:00, unless otherwise indicated
1q29r9h.why: In built-up areas, the no-parking ban applies from 8:00 to 20:00 unless otherwise indicated.

1xdzdd4.q: The sign shown can be supplemented by panels to indicate its start, continuation or end
1xdzdd4.why: Supplementary panels with arrows show where the ban starts, continues or ends.

16tumdc.q: The sign shown ceases to be valid after the first intersection, if not repeated
16tumdc.why: The ban lasts up to the first intersection and ends there unless the sign is repeated.

18ycmfc.why: A no-parking sign does not forbid stopping (fermata), a brief halt with the driver ready to move on.

1d7vxhu.q: The sign shown allows parking in the stretch before it
1d7vxhu.why: The ban applies only from the sign onward, not in the stretch before it.

19pikhf.q: The sign shown, suitably supplemented, can prohibit parking in built-up areas from 0:00 to 24:00
19pikhf.why: With a supplementary panel, the ban can apply 24 hours a day even in built-up areas.

13xnbp6.q: The sign shown prohibits parking, but not stopping
13xnbp6.why: A no-parking sign forbids parking (sosta) but allows stopping (fermata).

tjwpek.q: The sign shown marks the areas where it is forbidden to leave a vehicle parked
tjwpek.why: It marks areas where leaving a vehicle parked (in sosta) is forbidden.

18zrxa9.q: The sign shown, along extra-urban roads, indicates a permanent parking ban in the absence of supplementary indications
18zrxa9.why: Outside built-up areas the ban applies 24 hours a day unless otherwise indicated.

qqlpvf.q: Sign (A), if supplemented by panel (B), indicates a zone where parking is prohibited
qqlpvf.why: The no-parking sign (A) with panel (B) indicates a zone in which parking is prohibited.

ljuflq.q: The sign shown prohibits parking on the side of the road where it is placed
ljuflq.why: The ban applies only on the side of the road where the sign stands.

7ukt2d.q: Sign (A) with panel (B) prohibits parking only on working days
7ukt2d.why: The panel with crossed hammers means working days, so the ban applies only on those days, 8:00 to 20:00.

1g2tn2u.q: Sign (A), supplemented by panel (B), indicates a ZONA RIMOZIONE COATTA (forced removal zone)
1g2tn2u.why: The tow-truck panel means vehicles parked in the zone are towed away (rimozione coatta).

1be0huz.q: Sign (A), if supplemented by panel (B), indicates a zone where parking is prohibited, with removal of the vehicle
1be0huz.why: The tow-truck panel adds removal of the vehicle to the parking ban.

10mu1fg.q: The sign shown is a regulatory sign (segnale di prescrizione)
10mu1fg.why: It prohibits a behaviour, so it is a regulatory sign (segnale di prescrizione).

z1e6qn.q: The sign shown is not placed where parking is already prohibited by the general rule
z1e6qn.why: It is placed where parking would otherwise be allowed. Where the general rule already bans parking, the sign is not needed.

1w1dmar.q: The sign shown prohibits leaving the vehicle abandoned for a prolonged time
1w1dmar.why: The no-parking ban prevents leaving a vehicle unattended for a prolonged period.

oyyxrw.q: The sign shown, placed in built-up areas, normally prohibits parking from 8:00 to 20:00
oyyxrw.why: In built-up areas the ban normally applies from 8:00 to 20:00.

1bznxer.q: Sign (A), supplemented by panel (B), allows parking for buses
1bznxer.why: The panel reading 'eccetto' (except) with a bus excludes buses from the ban.

rk5ejb.q: Sign (A), supplemented by panel (B), prohibits parking only on public holidays
rk5ejb.why: The cross on the panel means public holidays (giorni festivi), so the ban applies only on those days, 8:00 to 20:00.

bmcvsy.q: The sign shown prohibits parking but not stopping
bmcvsy.why: A no-parking sign forbids parking (sosta) but allows stopping (fermata).

1krea1x.q: The sign shown, if placed on the left side of a one-way road, also prohibits parking on the right side
1krea1x.why: The ban applies only on the side where the sign is placed, not on the other side.

1y1io4a.q: The sign shown prohibits parking on the preceding stretch
1y1io4a.why: The panel with an upward arrow shows the ban continues ahead of the sign, not on the stretch before it.

1ykx7i8.q: The sign shown announces a stopping ban
1ykx7i8.why: It is the no-parking sign itself, not an advance warning, and it does not concern stopping (fermata).

tuxkkk.q: The sign shown does not apply to motorcycles and mopeds
tuxkkk.why: The ban applies to all vehicles, including motorcycles and mopeds.

1e6jc8t.q: With the sign shown, forced removal of the vehicle is always provided for
1e6jc8t.why: Forced removal (rimozione forzata) applies only when a panel says so, or in specific cases of obstruction or danger.

1vdc0mz.q: The sign shown indicates that parking is regulated with paid parking meters
1vdc0mz.why: Paid parking is shown by a parking sign. This sign forbids parking.

mhuu25.q: The sign shown allows parking for residents
mhuu25.why: It applies to all vehicles. An exception for residents would need a supplementary panel.

1r6gt5h.q: The sign shown allows parking by displaying the ticket issued by a parking meter
1r6gt5h.why: It prohibits parking and allows no exception by displaying a parking-meter ticket.

xdr75n.q: The sign shown, on extra-urban roads, allows parking after 20:00
xdr75n.why: Outside built-up areas the ban applies 24 hours a day, so also after 20:00.

1b2uhc7.q: The sign shown allows parking only for two-wheeled vehicles
1b2uhc7.why: The no-parking ban applies to all vehicles, including two-wheelers.

dl3a2b.q: The sign shown allows parking for motor quadricycles
dl3a2b.why: The ban applies to all vehicles, motor quadricycles included.

1jm33k9.q: The sign shown, in urban areas, prescribes a parking ban from 20:00 to 8:00, unless otherwise indicated
1jm33k9.why: In built-up areas the ban applies, unless otherwise indicated, from 8:00 to 20:00, not overnight.

xvfq3i.q: The sign shown indicates that parking is regulated by parking disc
xvfq3i.why: Parking with a disc (disco orario) is shown by a specific panel. The sign alone prohibits parking.

1d6mwi8.q: Sign (A), if supplemented by panel (B), is a permanent parking ban
1d6mwi8.why: The panel with two arrows shows the ban extends in both directions. It does not make the ban permanent.

8p7rwo.q: The sign shown, suitably supplemented, can prohibit double parking
8p7rwo.why: Double parking is already banned by the general rules. This sign does not regulate it.

1rqzbms.q: The sign shown prohibits the temporary suspension of movement for passengers to get on and off
1rqzbms.why: A no-parking sign does not forbid a brief stop (fermata) to let passengers on or off.

1sufnkf.q: Along extra-urban roads, the sign shown applies only during daylight hours
1sufnkf.why: Outside built-up areas the ban applies 24 hours a day, not only in daylight.

6hcp8n.q: The sign shown prohibits parking of vehicles on both sides of the carriageway
6hcp8n.why: A no-parking sign (divieto di sosta) applies only to the side of the road where it is placed, not to both sides.

14t93hv.q: The sign shown allows buses to park
14t93hv.why: The no-parking sign applies to all vehicles, buses included. Only an explicit exception on a panel could allow it.

1muoa2p.q: The sign shown allows mopeds to park
1muoa2p.why: The no-parking sign covers every vehicle, mopeds included, unless a supplementary panel says otherwise.

1k3hkq6.q: The sign shown prohibits the temporary halting of a vehicle
1k3hkq6.why: The no-stopping sign (crossed bars) forbids any voluntary stop of the vehicle, even a brief one.

ycsj31.q: The sign shown prohibits the voluntary stopping of all vehicles
ycsj31.why: The no-stopping sign (crossed bars) forbids any voluntary stop of the vehicle, even a brief one.

1ohgbgj.q: Along the roads where it is placed, the sign shown applies 24 hours a day
1ohgbgj.why: The no-stopping ban applies around the clock on urban and rural roads unless a panel gives specific hours.

kx5yek.q: The sign shown prohibits parking both by day and by night, even in built-up areas
kx5yek.why: The no-stopping ban also covers parking and applies day and night, in built-up areas too, with no time limits.

hbo5wm.q: The sign shown prohibits stopping for all vehicles
hbo5wm.why: The no-stopping sign (crossed bars) forbids any voluntary stop of the vehicle, even a brief one.

110cz81.q: The sign shown, in the absence of supplementary inscriptions, applies for the entire twenty-four hours
110cz81.why: With no supplementary panel, the no-stopping ban is valid for the full twenty-four hours.

1alb5qz.q: The sign shown prohibits any voluntary stopping of the vehicle
1alb5qz.why: The no-stopping sign (crossed bars) forbids any voluntary stop of the vehicle, even a brief one.

n2ktsp.q: Where the sign shown is present, removal of the vehicle is always ordered
n2ktsp.why: Where a no-stopping sign applies, forced removal (rimozione forzata) of the vehicle is always ordered.

18w7ca7.q: Sign (A), if supplemented by panel (B), prohibits stopping in the preceding stretch
18w7ca7.why: The no-stopping sign with an arrow panel pointing down means the ban applies to the stretch of road before the sign.

13g6w8s.q: Sign (A), if supplemented by panel (B), indicates the end of the stopping and parking ban
13g6w8s.why: With the down-arrow panel, the sign marks the end of the no-stopping ban, which includes parking as well.

98w0gv.q: The sign shown prohibits parking but allows stopping
98w0gv.why: The sign prohibits stopping (fermata), and therefore parking too. No voluntary halt is allowed.

1tnelx0.q: Along urban roads, the sign shown indicates that the stopping ban applies from 8.00 to 20.00
1tnelx0.why: The no-stopping ban applies 24 hours a day even in town. The 8:00-20:00 default concerns only no-parking signs.

1kazr4r.q: The sign shown allows stopping to let passengers board or alight
1kazr4r.why: The no-stopping sign has no exceptions, not even for picking up or dropping off passengers.

7nxqer.q: The sign shown allows stopping if the vehicle does not obstruct traffic
7nxqer.why: The no-stopping sign forbids any voluntary stop, even if the vehicle causes no obstruction.

1uf9jqz.q: The sign shown prohibits stopping but allows parking
1uf9jqz.why: Banning stopping also bans parking, which is just a longer halt.

8tnf5u.q: The sign shown does not apply to buses
8tnf5u.why: The no-stopping ban applies to all vehicles, buses included, unless the sign itself states an exception.

1p09bu0.q: The sign shown does not apply to taxis
1p09bu0.why: The no-stopping ban applies to taxis too; they have no exemption.

1wta7rv.q: The sign shown is an advance warning of a parking ban
1wta7rv.why: This is not an advance warning. It directly prohibits stopping where it is placed.

1rxk54s.q: The sign shown applies only on weekdays, unless otherwise indicated
1rxk54s.why: Without other indications, the no-stopping ban applies every day, around the clock, not just on weekdays.

z67b01.q: The sign shown allows the vehicle to stop for passengers to board and alight
z67b01.why: The no-stopping ban also forbids a brief halt to board or alight passengers.

16cw3ii.q: The sign shown announces the end of the parking ban
16cw3ii.why: The sign does not mark an ending. It prohibits stopping at the point where it is placed.

1dwznjm.q: The sign shown announces that there is a car park in the direction of the arrow
1dwznjm.why: The sign with the P and an arrow announces a parking area in the direction shown.

1ug83y2.q: The sign shown announces a parking area ahead in the direction of the arrow
1ug83y2.why: The sign with the P and an arrow announces a parking area in the direction shown.

tlvom4.q: The sign shown announces a car park 300 metres away in the direction of the arrow
tlvom4.why: The panel under the P gives the distance of 300 m to the car park, in the direction of the arrow.

1ox4chz.q: The sign shown announces a first-aid post in the direction of the arrow
1ox4chz.why: The white P on blue means parking. A first-aid post uses a different symbol (a cross).

1tg6mqn.q: The sign shown announces a prohibited car park in the direction of the arrow
1tg6mqn.why: The sign says a car park is available. It signals no prohibition.

1m55khc.q: The sign shown announces that stopping and parking are prohibited in the direction of the arrow
1m55khc.why: The sign shows a car park is ahead. It is not a ban on stopping or parking.

1pgw5ll.q: The sign shown announces to proceed further because the parking is reserved
1pgw5ll.why: The sign announces a car park 300 m away in the direction shown, not a reserved one to bypass.

1ih20o9.q: The sign shown prohibits parking at the place where it is placed
1ih20o9.why: The passo carrabile sign (driveway access) prohibits parking where it is placed, so the access stays clear.

1x0j05b.q: The sign shown indicates the area for vehicles to access adjacent properties
1x0j05b.why: The sign marks the area where vehicles enter adjoining properties, the driveway (passo carrabile).

10grwsi.q: The sign shown indicates the exit of a driveway
10grwsi.why: The sign marks the outlet of a driveway (passo carrabile) onto the road, where parking is prohibited.

nxu6gc.q: The sign shown allows stopping, provided the vehicle does not cause obstruction
nxu6gc.why: The sign bans only parking, so a brief stop is allowed if the vehicle does not block the access.

1u1mlf0.q: To be valid, the sign shown must contain the name of the authority that granted the authorisation, and the number and year of issue
1u1mlf0.why: The sign is valid only if it shows the issuing authority, number and year of authorisation, as in the picture.

1ogo63k.q: The sign shown is placed only on urban roads
1ogo63k.why: The driveway sign can also be placed outside built-up areas, not only on urban roads.

z6dx4b.q: The sign shown applies only in daylight hours
z6dx4b.why: The ban has no time limit and applies day and night, so the access stays clear at all times.

amkunv.q: The sign shown applies only at night
amkunv.why: The ban has no time limit and applies day and night, so the access stays clear at all times.

i7knnz.q: The sign shown allows parking for particular categories of vehicles
i7knnz.why: The sign prohibits parking for all vehicles, with no exception for specific categories.

1bsg8hh.q: The sign shown allows parking for first-aid vehicles that are not on duty
1bsg8hh.why: The ban applies to everyone, including emergency vehicles when they are off duty.

1e8u5rl.q: The sign shown allows parking for vehicles serving disabled people displaying the special permit
1e8u5rl.why: The no-parking sign with the disabled symbol makes an exception only for vehicles serving disabled people with the permit.

ej8qhi.q: The sign shown is a regulatory (prescription) sign
ej8qhi.why: A no-parking sign with an exception for disabled people is a regulatory sign (segnale di prescrizione) that imposes a rule.

16mjgzt.q: The sign shown represents a specific exception to the parking ban
16mjgzt.why: The no-parking sign with the disabled symbol makes an exception only for vehicles serving disabled people with the permit.

p97drh.q: The sign shown does not allow parking for vehicles other than those serving disabled people
p97drh.why: Only vehicles serving disabled people may park; the parking ban still applies to all other vehicles.

xnln0o.q: The sign shown allows school buses to park
xnln0o.why: The only exception to the ban is for vehicles serving disabled people, not school buses.

7g41so.q: The sign shown indicates a lane reserved for vehicles serving disabled people
7g41so.why: The sign concerns parking, not a reserved lane. It shows who may park there: vehicles serving disabled people.

to5ujv.q: The sign shown is a parking ban for vehicles serving disabled people, and indicates the nearest car park
to5ujv.why: The sign allows parking for vehicles serving disabled people. It neither bans them nor points to the nearest car park.

1pzzhuf.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a zone closed to regular traffic because it is equipped for disabled people
1pzzhuf.why: The sign gives no advance notice of any zone. It regulates parking where it is placed.

89ooc3.q: The sign shown, on the road where it is placed, allows only vehicles serving disabled people to pass
89ooc3.why: The sign regulates parking, not passage. Traffic remains open to all vehicles.

i3gsqq.q: The sign shown allows mopeds and motorcycles to park
i3gsqq.why: Parking is allowed only for vehicles serving disabled permit holders, not for mopeds and motorcycles in general.

19e3et3.q: The sign shown allows parking by displaying the ticket issued by a parking meter
19e3et3.why: The sign has nothing to do with paid parking. The exception is only for vehicles serving disabled people.

5eafy7.q: The sign shown represents a regulation of parking
5eafy7.why: The sign with time bands regulates parking: banned 7:00-9:00 and 17:00-20:00, allowed 9:00-17:00 and 20:00-7:00.

wohl3q.q: The sign shown allows parking from 9.00 to 17.00
wohl3q.why: The sign with time bands regulates parking: banned 7:00-9:00 and 17:00-20:00, allowed 9:00-17:00 and 20:00-7:00.

1hge1oh.q: The sign shown prohibits parking from 17.00 to 20.00
